product.name: Monoprice Multi-Mode OM3 Fiber Optic Cable - Reverse Polarity LC-LC Uniboot UL 50/125 OFNR Aqua 2m
product.description: This UL® listed 50/125µm OM3 fiber optic cable features an extremely high bandwidth, making it suitable for high‑throughput enterprise network, telecomm room, server farm, and cloud storage network applications. The LC Uniboot connector design allows two fibers to be carried in one jacket with modified LC duplex connectors. Compared to traditional LC duplex jumpers, the uniboot connector effectively reduces installation volume by 50%, which reduces the surface area of the cable and optimizes airflow in data centers and wiring closets.Normally, there is a transmitting signal terminal (Tx) and a receiving signal terminal (Rx). The Uniboot connector is an innovative design that allows the fiber polarity to be switched without the need for special tools.Features: Uniboot design allows two fibers to be carried inside a single jacket, improving airflow and cable management in tight spacesEasily reverse the polarity without any toolsHigh quality OM3 multi‑mode fiber cable with LC/LC connectors is perfect for high‑throughput applicationsSupports 10Gb to distances up to 300 meters, and 40Gb and 100Gb up to 100 metersEffective Modal Bandwidth (EMB) of 2000 MHz/km at 850nmOFNR (riser) rated fiber cable is ideal for use in upright shafts that run between floors in commercial class buildingsThe small LC connector is perfect for high density network applicationsUse with LED and VCSEL laser light sourcesBackward compatible with LED‑based 50/125 multi‑mode fiber applications Support Files: Linecard (Feb 14, 2023)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
